items.title: General Deliverance
items.description: Experience supernatural liberation, healing, and spiritual renewal through intense prayer, God's Word, and anointed deliverance ministry.

items.title: Church Anniversary
items.description: Join us as we celebrate God’s unwavering faithfulness, grace, and impact over the years with a special service of praise, worship, and thanksgiving.

items.title: Weekend of Power
items.description: An intensive weekend encounter filled with explosive worship, deep teaching, and miraculous manifestations of God’s power and presence.

items.description: A sacred service set apart for the impartation of the Holy Spirit, divine healing, and the breaking of yokes through the power of the anointing.

items.title: General Night Vigil
items.description: Join us for an empowering midnight encounter as we gather for extended prayer, prophetic worship, and spiritual warfare to command our morning.
